beast.desc: Animals and natural monsters: hides, fangs, meat.

humanoid.desc: Raiders and warbands: weapons, armour, rations, coin.

undead.desc: The restless dead: bones, old steel, holy trinkets.

rift.desc: Rift and Scar creatures: ichor, crystals and cores.

chest_treasure.desc: Strongboxes with real money in them.

dungeon_crypt.desc: Crypts: undead leavings and burial goods.

dungeon_cave.desc: Caves and mines: ores, gems, beast remains.

dungeon_ruin.desc: Ruins: old steel, lore and trinkets.

dungeon_warren.desc: Goblin warrens: scraps, stolen goods, raw meat.

tower.desc: Tower floors: arcane treasure, cores and relics.

boss.desc: Boss rewards: the best gear a tier can give.

bandit_camp.desc: Bandit camps: loot from the road.

orc_camp.desc: Orc camps: tusks, rough steel, strong drink.
